b_plus.meaning: forced_end = pos; breaking the habit picks the +label

b_sham.meaning: forced_end = neg; breaking the habit picks the sham label

break_rates.identity: Delta_first = 1/2 * (b_plus - b_sham) under EXACT forced-end counterbalancing (AMENDMENT 2 (v)); the weighted form n+/N*b+ + ns/N*(1-bs) - 1/2 reproduces the measured primary at any balance

powered_effect_in_break_terms.note: §3's powered Delta = +0.15 is a break-rate difference of 0.30 against a base of ~0.17. e2d tests whether a 2x MED state overrides the alternation habit at that scale.

frame_M.rule_11: post-hoc frame on committed data; licenses a frame and a secondary, never a verdict

_no_verdict: measurement only; the criteria live in scripts/e2d_d2_analyze.py
